title: The Morning Digest: September 27, 2026
dek: "Trump publicly rejected Iran's 7-day Hormuz plan Saturday, Friday's crude selloff may not survive the Sunday reopen. But Gulf tanker volumes have doubled in a month, so the premium is doing more work than the flows. Joliet still only partially back; WTI specs sit at the 96th percentile of length."
